name: simple-todo
description: The smallest thing worth calling a backend: one entity, four fields, and no authorization at all. Everyone may do everything, so every request here is a plain HTTP call with no credential — which is what makes the descriptor the whole story.

title.description: What is to be done. Required, so a paged list may sort by it.

status.description: Where the item stands. Required, so a paged list may sort by it too.

description.description: The longer version, if there is one.

due_on.description: When it is due. Nullable on purpose — which also makes it the field a paged `order=due_on` is refused on (issue #116), and the suite pins that.
